mapper.select: SELECT ROOM_OPTION_SN, ROOM_SN, OPTION_NM, ADD_AMT, SORT_SEQ, REG_DT, MDFCN_DT FROM ROOM_OPTION WHERE ROOM_SN = #{roomSn} AND DEL_YN = 'N' ORDER BY SORT_SEQ ASC, ROOM_OPTION_SN ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE ROOM_OPTION RO JOIN ROOM R ON R.ROOM_SN = RO.ROOM_SN AND R.DEL_YN = 'N' JOIN HOUSE H ON H.HOUSE_SN = R.HOUSE_SN AND H.PRTNR_SN = #{prtnrSn} AND H.DEL_YN = 'N' SET RO.DEL_YN = 'Y', RO.MDFCN_DT = UTC_TIMESTAMP(6), RO.MDFR_SN = #{mdfrSn} WHERE RO.ROOM_SN = #{roomSn} AND RO.DEL_YN = 'N'
